description: Records the final score of the signed-in player's Swiss table, for a game not tracked on Praetorium, and finishes its battle; it counts for the tournament's standings but not the leaderboard. Report only a score both players agree. Defaults to your table this round. A result locks once the next round is paired; then only the organizer can reopen it. Requires mcp:write.

eventToken.description: eventToken from list_my_events; only an old link needs it.

missionPackId.description: A mission pack id from list_reference; omit for the current pack, as the site does.

token.description: The tournament or hidden-list game token, from list_my_events or its invite link.

name: report_table_result
title: Report my table’s score
